newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal edges up, deposits barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal edges up, deposits barely changed.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal edged slightly firmer on the dollar this week but riyal interbank deposit rates were barely changed in very quiet trade.
Dealers said tensions in the Gulf after last week's U.S. missile attacks on Iraq had not affected the market. "The market was very quiet. It focused on short-dated funds," one said.

Spot-next and one-week deposits were at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent. One-month funds were 5-9/16, 7/16 percent and three months were 5-11/16, 9/16 percent. Six month rates were 5-15/16, 13/16 percent and one-year funds were at 6-1/4, 1/8 percent. The spot riyal was at 3.7505/06 on the dollar from 3.7506/08.
